standard: landed-regions-standard-1018: local region trees, every cross-region net LANDED, per-region child-flop gate (TT and FF <= 80 ps); 1-bit reset runs are the only plain cross-region hops
window: (1 - 2) T + t_hold < dL < 1 T - t_cq - t_setup at TT and FF

loose_status.note: sticky status flags (no reservation / valid / payload effect): landed, outside the offset solve; the reader sees each flag lag_edges later than the flat parent

reset.why: Die releases all local reset ports on the same booked edge; no long cross-region reset net.
reset.copies_note: last regional stage as kept parallel copies (<= 32 loads each), same reset age, no added edge
reset.note: flat reference == landed parent with its reset delayed by depth; child c's reset run is depth + t(c)

compiler.note: every latency change vs the flat parent; the compiler schedule takes these (static calendar, no runtime flow control)
compiler.reschedule_note: RESCHEDULE mode: cross-region loops; every child keeps its flat calendar (t = 0) and each landed net above arrives +2 edges later than in the flat parent: the compiler / the children's static calendars must absorb these

die_obligations: drop one clock per region at the region's clock port (ck_<r>); each region builds its own local tree
communicating regions (landed pairs) need NO phase alignment inside the landing window at TT and FF

regional reset ports rst_n_core, rst_n_r1, rst_n_r2, rst_n_r3, rst_n_r4, rst_n_r5, rst_n_r6, rst_n_r7, rst_n_r8, rst_n_r9, rst_n_r10, rst_n_r11, rst_n_r12, rst_n_r13, rst_n_r14, rst_n_r15, rst_n_r16, rst_n_r17, rst_n_r18, rst_n_r19, rst_n_r20, rst_n_r21, rst_n_r22, rst_n_r23, rst_n_r24, rst_n_r25, rst_n_r26, rst_n_r27, rst_n_r28, rst_n_r29, rst_n_r30, rst_n_r31, rst_n_r32, rst_n_r33, rst_n_r34, rst_n_r35, rst_n_r36, rst_n_r37, rst_n_r38: the die releases every one on the SAME edge (its own landed reset distribution, fixed depth), each timed on its region clock
